theorems.name: Submission.ble_sac_ray_sq_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Rn n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → ∀ (x : Rn n), ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ τ : ℝ, τ ≤ 1 → ENNReal.ofReal (1 - τ) * ‖φ x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (∫⁻ t in Icc τ 1, ‖φ (t • x)‖ₑ ^ 2) + 2 * ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - τ) ^ 2) * ∫⁻ σ in Icc τ 1, ‖gradient φ (σ • x)‖ₑ ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
